provenanceOrphanBaseline.reason: Bump-in-CI: npm derives provenance from GITHUB_SHA, the commit the publish workflow was triggered at (32435898, manifest 6.6.0-prerelease), while the version was bumped in-CI afterwards and pushed as 55f971b7 (manifest 6.6.0). The attested tree therefore never shipped, and a re-pack at it diverges on dist/. Same defect as 6.5.0/6.5.1; the durable fix is to push the bump commit BEFORE publishing so the attested SHA is the shipped tree.

Bump-in-CI: the publish run bumped the version in-tree, so the attested commit 7b853622 pre-dates the v6.5.1 tag at de394ae21. Frozen history — remedying it means tagging an immutable published release.
Bump-in-CI: attested commit e66bd62b carries a 6.4.0 manifest, while v6.5.0 sits at the later bump commit 48b2ba50. Neither tag reaches the attested tree and neither can be moved.
Bump-in-CI: attested commit 2d246cc2 is not the v6.3.0 tag target 4cb8f2a08. Pre-dates the tag/provenance discipline.
